title: Ye Qing's Condition
next_chapter_hook: When Ye Qing's silhouette vanished into the night, Chen Ji clutched the ice-cold Jade Slip in his palm, his fingertips trembling slightly—Deep within the Dragon Vein, what had Chen Nian endured?

text.content: The lingering essence of the Fake Death Pill circulated slowly through his meridians. Chen Ji maintained a faint vital energy, like a fish in a deep pool, waiting for the opportune moment. The warmth of the firelight gradually receded, the air thick with the mingled scent of burnt wood and blood. He had thought this night would pass in silence, until a wisp of chilling fragrance brushed against his nose.

Chen Ji's heart tightened. To outsiders, he appeared completely lifeless, but Ye Qing's voice was like a key, precisely inserted into the gap he had deliberately left. He didn't open his eyes, merely scanning with his spiritual sense—the newcomer was shrouded in faint demonic mist, bearing Ye Qing's unique aura.

dialogue.content: ...You certainly know how to pick your timing.

text.content: He opened his eyes, meeting Ye Qing's gaze that seemed to pierce through everything. In the firelight, her complexion appeared paler than their last meeting, with faint dark circles beneath her eyes—clearly, she hadn't slept well for many days. The Holy Sect's saintess of the Demonic Path, yet she had infiltrated the heart of Tianqing Sect alone, just to see a 'dead man'.

dialogue.content: The hidden clause of the Heavenly Fate Pact—you probably don't know about it yet, do you?

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely gazing at her quietly. Ye Qing drew a Jade Slip from her sleeve, its surface emanating a ghostly glow. Countless delicate runes were carved upon it, faintly releasing a heart-stopping fluctuation.

dialogue.content: When I signed the Heavenly Fate Pact with you back then, I added a clause unknown even to my Holy Sect—if you die, I must use every means to escort your sister Chen Nian to a safe place.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He had never told Ye Qing about Chen Nian, even deliberately concealing his sister's existence when signing the Heavenly Fate Pact. Yet Ye Qing clearly knew everything, even hiding this clause in the most secretive corner of the contract.

dialogue.content: How do you know about her existence?

text.content: Did you think the Mo Xiansheng on that contract came from nowhere?

This sentence silenced Chen Ji. Mo Xiansheng, that remnant soul guardian, had always appeared as the guide of the Tianji Record. But Ye Qing's words hinted at another possibility—Mo Xiansheng's layout extended far deeper than he had imagined.

dialogue.content: I'm here to tell you the truth. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets is not merely a consciousness; it was formed by the fusion of seven ancient powerhouses' souls, each of whom had once been a holder of the Tianji Record. And your sister Chen Nian is the seventh—the one chosen to become the new vessel.

text.content: Chen Ji's hand tightened involuntarily, his knuckles whitening. The truth about the Eye of Heavenly Secrets struck his heart like a heavy hammer. Every generation's prophet had been a chess piece, and he was merely one of them. But what chilled him even more—was Chen Nian actually chosen to become the new vessel of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions in his heart, his gaze refocusing on Ye Qing.

choices.description: She risked exposure to come here, so she must have sincerity. Listen to what she has to say before making a judgment.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Internal Intelligence on the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing is deceiving, he will fall into a passive situation

text.content: When Ye Qing saw the change in Chen Ji's expression, the corner of her lips lifted slightly. She knew he had made his choice.

choices.description: Why would she tell him all this? The Holy Sect's saintess of the Demonic Path cannot be trusted lightly.

text.content: Ye Qing's gaze cooled, but she didn't flare up. It seemed she had anticipated this question from Chen Ji long ago.

Ye Qing's voice was soft, yet it exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. His breathing hastened, the pent-up anxiety and worry of many days nearly breaking through the dam of his rationality at this moment. Chen Nian—the sister who had been missing for years, the one he had been secretly searching for with no leads—actually was in the depths of the Dragon Vein?

dialogue.content: The Dragon Vein... isn't that the forbidden land jointly guarded by the three major sects?
The three major sects are merely gatekeepers for the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Every generation's 'prodigies' are sacrifices sent into the Dragon Vein. And your sister is the final key.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He recalled the prophecy about Chen Nian in the Tianji Record—any foresight involving her was blurred. Heavenly Fate Key, so that was her true identity. She was not only Chen Ji's weakness but also the most crucial chess piece in the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' grand scheme.

dialogue.content: I have a plan. After the fake death, you and I join forces to infiltrate the Dragon Vein and rescue your sister before she is sacrificed.

choice.prompt: With Ye Qing's plan laid out, Chen Ji needed to make a decision.

choices.description: For Chen Nian, he was willing to ally with the Demonic Sect's saintess. The enemy of my enemy is a friend.
choices.risk_hint: The Dragon Vein Forbidden Land is Extremely Dangerous

text.content: Ye Qing nodded slightly, her eyes gleaming. She had waited for this answer for a long time.

choices.description: One cannot fully trust the Demonic Sect's saintess; he needs more leverage and guarantees.

text.content: Ye Qing laughed lightly, seemingly having anticipated Chen Ji's caution long ago. She drew another Jade Slip from her sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji.
Ye Qing drew another Jade Slip from her sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji. The Jade Slip felt ice-cold in his hand, engraved with three ancient runes—a core roster of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

dialogue.content: This is my final sincerity. Everyone on this roster has been marked as a chess piece by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, including Ling Yuan and Han Lie.

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the Jade Slip, his brow furrowing slightly. Ling Yuan—that old sect master who appeared to shelter him while secretly harboring malicious intent—was also a chess piece of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. What did this mean? How much of his own plans had been manipulated by others?

dialogue.content: I know what you're thinking. But now is not the time for settling accounts; rescuing your sister is the top priority.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the Jade Slip into his sleeve. He raised his head, his gaze meeting Ye Qing's. The distant firelight danced, stretching their two silhouettes long across the ground. In this moment, they were no longer opposing sides of righteousness and evil, but chess pieces trapped within the same grand game.

dialogue.content: Deep within the Dragon Vein... I need more intelligence. Where is the entrance? How many guards are there? Where exactly is Chen Nian being held?

text.content: A hint of appreciation flickered in Ye Qing's eyes. She appreciated this straightforward, efficient style.

dialogue.content: The Dragon Vein entrance lies beneath the abyss at the junction of the three major sects. On the night of each full moon, the guards are weakest. Your sister is imprisoned at the deepest altar, personally guarded by Ling Yuan. To rescue her, you must first deal with this old fox.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan—that greatest threat lurking in the shadows.

choices.text: Formulate a Plan Against Ling Yuan
choices.description: Since Ling Yuan is a chess piece of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, dismantle him from within.
choices.visible_reward: Destroying a Key Chess Piece of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is Cunning and Deep, Not Easy to Deal With

text.content: Ye Qing nodded slightly, her gaze toward Chen Ji growing more serious. She realized this seemingly worthless servant disciple was far more formidable than she had imagined.

choices.text: Invoke the Tianji Record for Foresight
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to foresee the future confrontation with Ling Yuan, finding the best timing for action.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Points are Precious, Do Not Use Lightly

text.content: The Tianji Record warmed slightly in his palm, the runes on the fragment beginning to flow slowly. But just then, Chen Ji suddenly withdrew his hand—he sensed interference from Chen Nian's presence.

Chen Ji did not invoke the Tianji Record. He vaguely felt that whenever he tried to foresee a future related to Chen Nian, the Tianji Record's foresight would become blurred. Perhaps as Ye Qing had said, Chen Nian was his variable—his weakness and the key to breaking the chess game.

dialogue.content: Next time we meet will be on the full moon night. Deep beneath the abyss, be there or be square.

text.content: Ye Qing's silhouette gradually merged into the night, leaving only a faint lingering fragrance. Chen Ji stood in place, clutching the Jade Slip inscribed with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' roster, his thoughts churning. He had thought his chess game was grand enough, yet he never imagined the true board was far vaster than he had ever conceived.

dialogue.content: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets... Ling Yuan... Chen Nian...

text.content: He murmured these names softly, yet a meaningful arc curled at the corner of his lips. The larger the chess game, the more variables; and the more variables, the more opportunities for a true master. Ling Yuan was a chess piece of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, Ye Qing was a chess piece of the Holy Sect, and he, Chen Ji—from the very beginning—was no one's chess piece.

Just as Ye Qing was about to vanish from the edge of his vision, her voice drifted back once more, as light as a leaf floating in the night wind. When Ye Qing's silhouette vanished into the night, Chen Ji clutched the ice-cold Jade Slip in his palm, his fingertips trembling slightly—Deep within the Dragon Vein, what had Chen Nian endured?
